{"command": "cat > tests/test_filter.py <<EOF
from app.api.handlers import handle_filter_users

def test_filter_users():
    # Valid
    status, response = handle_filter_users({"where": "id == 1"})
    assert status == 200
    assert response == {"users": [{"id": 1, "name": "Ada", "email": "ada@example.com"}]}
    
    # Valid and
    status, response = handle_filter_users({"where": "id > 0 and name == 'Linus'"})
    assert status == 200
    assert response == {"users": [{"id": 2, "name": "Linus", "email": "linus@example.com"}]}
    
    # Invalid missing
    status, response = handle_filter_users({})
    assert status == 400
    assert "error" in response
    
    # Invalid type
    status, response = handle_filter_users({"where": 123})
    assert status == 400
    
    # Invalid expression
    status, response = handle_filter_users({"where": "id + 1 == 2"})
    assert status == 400

    # Invalid function
    status, response = handle_filter_users({"where": "len(name) > 0"})
    assert status == 400
EOF
pytest tests/test_filter.py
"}
